purpose: Permit a fully numeric audited hybrid SOTP/APV result while same-perimeter segment panels are materialized and tested. These wide priors must be replaced segment by segment when an OOS-qualified posterior is available.
interpretation_rules: A triangular mode is an explicit analyst center, not an empirical most-likely frequency.
Do not relabel prior-predictive path weights as calibrated target-company probabilities.
Publish the prior version, endpoints, sensitivity contribution and replacement status beside P50 and entry price.
Do not use current share price, broker target price or prior valuation output to set a bound or mode.

korean_air_standalone_current_anchor.use: forecast origin and arithmetic reconciliation; not a probability sample

bounded_priors.basis: Analyst downside/base/upside envelope around the observed 2026Q2 standalone load factor of 0.871.
Analyst envelope spanning contraction to high-single-digit growth; mode is the midpoint of the documented base range.
Analyst normalization envelope; fuel and FX paths must move jointly so the same shock is not charged twice.
Analyst normalization envelope around the unusually elevated 2026Q2 cargo yield.
Wide analyst sensitivity anchored by 2026H1 pre-elimination operating loss and capped at a mature but non-exceptional airline margin; it is not an empirical Asiana posterior.
Analyst timing sensitivity for post-merger operating repair.
Zero-to-company-plan sensitivity. The KRW300bn company plan includes financing benefit, so each draw must be split before operating APV.
Explicit analyst split sensitivity; unavailable company disclosure prevents calibration. The residual may enter financing effects only once.
Broad analyst sensitivity for systems, service, fleet and workforce integration costs; no company amount is disclosed.
Analyst timing sensitivity, separate from the legally planned merger date.
Analyst envelope around disclosed backlog conversion and external MRO reference economics; not an airline traffic posterior.

legal_merger_base_case.rule: Do not invent a calibrated close probability. Run announced-close, delay and cancellation cases and show each contribution.

aggregate_distress_asset_proceeds_ratio.basis: Analyst sensitivity applied to path-date unlevered asset value, not an asserted airline recovery statistic.

distress_transaction_cost_ratio_of_proce.basis: Analyst sensitivity until claim-level collateral and sale evidence is available.

distress_sensitivity_priors.old_shareholder_recovery_rule: Residual after evidenced senior claims and distress costs; never set ex ante to zero and never floor a present-date DCF scenario.

replacement_policy: When a segment posterior passes the panel and OOS contract, replace only that segment's operating priors. Keep data-short integration and distress terms as separately labeled analyst priors until direct evidence supports them.
